items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: I knew George Smith. He was a trumpet player. Nice fella.

ctx.x: I believe Braggs could have answered that better than me. Oh. Because Braggs knew him. And I didn't hear Sid. I knew others.
And they had the big six comedy jazz marines, George Washington Smith.

And that was here. That's the one that Dre's woman wanted me to get his address. But this boy would never talk to him. So I was unable to locate anything on George Smith. I knew George Smith. He was a trumpet player. Nice fella. He could play a fairly good trumpet. W.H. Hawkins brass band sounded good.
